import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.Arrays;

public class Main {

    static long nbDigits(long n) {
        n = n < 0 ? -n : n;
        long digits = 0;
        while (n != 0) {
            ++digits;
            n /= 10;
        }
        return digits;
    }

    static long ones(long n) {
        long res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            res = 10 * res + 1;
        return res;
    }

    static long aux2(long n) {
        if (n == 0) return 0;
        n = n < 0 ? -n : n;
        long d = nbDigits(n);
        return d + aux2(n - ones(d));
    }

    static long aux(long n, long sign, long acc, long max, int[] already_in) {
        if (acc >= max) return max;
        if (n == 0) return acc;
        if (n < 0) {
            n = -n;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        long d = nbDigits(n);
        long ones_d = ones(d);
        long res1 = max, res2 = max;

        if (0 <= already_in[(int)d] * sign && -10 < already_in[(int)d] && already_in[(int)d] < 10) {
            already_in[(int)d] += sign;
            res1 = aux(n - ones_d, sign, acc + d, max, already_in);
            already_in[(int)d] -= sign;
        }
        if (0 <= already_in[(int)(d + 1)] * sign && -10 < already_in[(int)(d + 1)] && already_in[(int)(d + 1)] < 10) {
            already_in[(int)(d + 1)] += sign;
            res2 = aux(n - 10 * ones_d - 1, sign, acc + d + 1, res1, already_in);
            already_in[(int)(d + 1)] -= sign;
        }
        return res1 < res2 ? res1 : res2;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int[] already_in = new int[20];
        Arrays.fill(already_in, 0);
        long result = aux(n, 1, 0, aux2(n), already_in);
        System.out.println(result);
        sc.close();
    }
}
